scope: Standalone lossless GPU transfer codec: all 28 layers use our Dense or Rank256 predictor/rANS. The current single-feature rolling encoder and two-chunk packed-inverse decoder are the reference. The candidate changes only exact renormalization-word prefix compaction to warp ballot/popcount. Original complete packets, fitted coefficients, probabilities, rANS state updates and BF16 words stay fixed. Both modes retain the same 45,568 shared inverse-table bytes; prefix compaction adds no device tables. SplitZip and ExANS remain separate unchanged controls, not candidate components. 512-token graph execution and 8K borrowed-input direct execution are retained. The two documents are reused engineering evidence, not independent generalization. Link costs are calculated, not NIC/SSD, resident P or serving measurements.
